from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Party(BaseModel):
    """A legal party identified in the judgment."""
    role: str | None = Field(description="Role in the case (e.g., Appellant, Appellee, Petitioner)")
    name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the party")

class FinancialEntry(BaseModel):
    """A monetary figure mentioned in the judgment (fee, compensation, fine)."""
    amount: float | None = Field(description="Monetary amount")
    description: str | None = Field(description="What the amount is for (e.g., 'Appeal fee', 'Compensation')")
    type: str | None = Field(description="Category of money (e.g., 'Fee', 'Compensation', 'Fine')")
    bearer: str | None = Field(description="Who pays or receives this amount")

class Identifier(BaseModel):
    """Specific identifiers like case numbers or patent numbers."""
    type: str | None = Field(description="Type of identifier (e.g., Case Number, Patent Number)")
    value: str | None = Field(description="The value of the identifier")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Data extracted from a single judgment document."""
    # Document identification
    document_titles: list[str | None] = Field(default_factory=list, description="Titles of the judgment document")
    case_numbers: list[str | None] = Field(default_factory=list, description="Official case numbers cited in the text")
    
    # Parties
    parties: list[Party] = Field(default_factory=list, description="List of parties involved")
    
    # Ruling
    dispositions: list[str | None] = Field(default_factory=list, description="Main judicial outcomes or rulings")
    specific_orders: list[str | None] = Field(default_factory=list, description="Specific orders (e.g., pay X, stop infringement)")
    
    # Financials
    costs: list[FinancialEntry] = Field(default_factory=list, description="Court costs and fees")
    monetary_awards: list[FinancialEntry] = Field(default_factory=list, description="Compensation or fines awarded")
    
    # Identifiers
    identifiers: list[Identifier] = Field(default_factory=list, description="Case numbers, patent numbers, etc.")
